boundaries.name: leafHash
boundaries.obligation: `<IndexedMerkleLeaf as Leafable>::hash` (Poseidon over the 18 leaf words) is modelled as the opaque callback `Commitment.leafHash`; no property of Poseidon is assumed or proved.

boundaries.name: merklePathFold
boundaries.obligation: `MerkleProof::get_root` / `::verify` and `IncrementalMerkleTree::get_root` / `::prove` (merkle_tree.rs, incremental_merkle_tree.rs) are the opaque callbacks `Commitment.rootFrom` / `root` / `path`; their internal correctness is not modelled.

boundaries.name: commitmentLaws
boundaries.obligation: `CommitmentLaws` (openSet, pathStable, extendEmpty) asserts the incremental Merkle tree behaves honestly; it is assumed, used only for the native completeness theorem, and shown consistent only via the non-cryptographic `transparent` witness.

boundaries.name: binding
boundaries.obligation: `Binding` (a sibling list opening leaf L at index i to the tree root forces L to be the tree's leaf at i) is Poseidon collision resistance plus leaf-encoding injectivity; only the encoding half is proved (`leaf_words_injective`).

boundaries.name: pushCapacityAssert
boundaries.obligation: `IncrementalMerkleTree::push` aborts the process when the tree is full; the model has no panic, only the `size < capacity` hypothesis and the `Wf.capacity` field.

boundaries.name: u256RangeInvariant
boundaries.obligation: Rust's `U256` guarantees every key and next_key is below 2^256; in the model this is an explicit hypothesis (`key < keyBound`) and a `Wf.in_range` field, not a refinement of the limb type.

boundaries.name: plonky2Lowering
boundaries.obligation: `is_lt` / `is_zero` / `assert_one` / `conditional_assert_eq` / `select` and the whole CircuitBuilder plumbing are assumed to lower to exactly the `Gates` / `ConditionalGates` predicates; no gate-level refinement is proved.

boundaries.name: prevRootChaining
boundaries.obligation: That the `prev_root` fed to an insertion proof is the current nullifier/account tree root, and that the key is the nullifier of the spend being authorised, are consumer obligations of the balance and claim circuits, outside these three files.

boundaries.name: serdeRoundTrip
boundaries.obligation: `Serialize`/`Deserialize` derives on the leaf, tree and proof types are not modelled.
